description: Source file implementing command graph management and execution for Vulkan rendering in ANGLE, including command buffer initialization, resource dependency management, and diagnostic dumping.

classes.name: CommandGraph
classes.description: Manages a directed acyclic graph of command nodes for Vulkan command submission, including dependency management, diagnostics, and resource tracking.

classes.name: CommandGraphNode
classes.description: Represents a node in the command graph, encapsulating a Vulkan command buffer and its dependencies, execution logic, and diagnostic info.

classes.name: CommandGraphResource
classes.description: Represents a resource in the command graph, managing dependencies and command recording related to that resource.

classes.name: SharedGarbage
classes.description: Handles deferred destruction of Vulkan objects, ensuring resources are released after GPU completion.

methods.name: allocateNode
methods.description: Allocates a new command graph node with a specified function.

methods.name: allocateBarrierNode
methods.description: Allocates a barrier node with specific resource type and ID, and sets it as a barrier.

methods.name: setNewBarrier
methods.description: Sets a new barrier node, establishing dependencies from previous barriers.

methods.name: submitCommands
methods.description: Submits the command graph to Vulkan, executing nodes in dependency order.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the command graph, freeing resources and resetting state.

methods.name: dumpGraphDotFile
methods.description: Outputs the command graph in Graphviz dot format for diagnostics.
